shortDescription: Transfer files from or to remote Ruckus ICX 7000 series switches

options.name: download
options.description: Name of the resource to be downloaded. Mutually exclusive with upload.

options.name: protocol
options.description: Data transfer protocol to be used

options.name: public_key
options.description: public key type to be used to login to scp server

options.name: remote_filename
options.description: The name or path of the remote file/resource to be uploaded or downloaded.

options.name: remote_pass
options.description: remote password to be used for scp login.

options.name: remote_port
options.description: The port number of the remote host. Default values will be selected based on protocol type. Default scp:22, http:443

options.name: remote_server
options.description: IP address of the remote server

options.name: remote_user
options.description: remote username to be used for scp login.

options.name: upload
options.description: Name of the resource to be uploaded. Mutually exclusive with download.
